reasoning: On the season so far the 76ers are the stronger team; with home court the 76ers start about 12 points better, in a game of about 229 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Bucks.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the 76ers win 82 times in 100, by about 11; most games like this end between 203 and 251 total points.
